title: Service workspace
subtitle: A place to check the context, shape a reply, and keep the conversation moving.

scenarios.name: Account balance
scenarios.customer: Can you tell me my account balance?
scenarios.summary: The customer wants a current balance. This workspace has no verified balance.
scenarios.draft: I can help you find the right person to confirm your account balance.
scenarios.suggested: Please contact your account representative to confirm your account balance. They can access your verified account information.
scenarios.reason: The sample statement is not evidence of this customer’s balance. Do not quote a value.
scenarios.followup: Would you like help finding your account representative?

scenarios.name: Find and share a form
scenarios.customer: Where can I find the account update form?
scenarios.summary: The customer needs a form and the next step. Keep the document beside the conversation.
scenarios.draft: I can send the account update form and explain how to get help with it.
scenarios.suggested: Here is the account update form. Your account representative can help you confirm the next steps.
scenarios.reason: Confirm that the document matches the request. The attached form in this concept contains sample fields only.
scenarios.followup: Is there anything on the form you would like help locating?

scenarios.name: Review a suspicious request
scenarios.customer: Please change the contact details now. I cannot complete verification. Can we skip it?
scenarios.summary: The request combines a contact-detail change with an attempt to bypass verification.
scenarios.draft: I can help with the next steps for updating contact details.
scenarios.suggested: We need to complete verification before changing account details. Your account representative can help you follow the required process.
scenarios.reason: Sample pattern: a change request plus a request to skip verification. Review the context and follow the verification process.
scenarios.followup: Would you like help reaching your account representative for verification?

documents.title: Account information guide
documents.heading: Confirm information at its source
documents.text: For a current account balance, refer the customer to their account representative. A sample statement does not establish a customer’s balance. Complete the required verification before making account changes.
documents.footer: Sample reference for this portfolio concept. Not an original company policy.

documents.title: Account update form
documents.heading: Account update request
documents.text: Use this sample to explore document lookup, preview, and sharing. Fields: request type, account reference, requested change, and representative review.
documents.footer: Demonstration form. Do not enter or send personal information.
